janmaStory.score: The score pattern shows {{overallScore}}; strengths cluster around {{strengths}}, while {{weaknesses}} ask for conscious handling.

horaverse.awakening.title: Welcome, {{name}}. The Hora opens.
horaverse.awakening.line1: At {{time}} on {{date}}, the birth moment settles into the wheel of time.
horaverse.awakening.line2: From {{place}}, under {{latitude}} and {{longitude}}, the sky fixes its first doorway.
horaverse.awakening.line3: The Panchang brings its first signal: {{panchang}}.

horaverse.solarRing.title: {{ascendant}} rises at the eastern gate
horaverse.solarRing.line1: Each house becomes a chamber in the same wheel, carrying work, family, desire, memory, courage, and release.
horaverse.solarRing.line2: The Moon rests in {{sign}}, inside house {{house}}: the field of {{houseMeaning}}. Here the mind does not move as a dry planet marker; it searches for rhythm, belonging, and the right emotional doorway inside that life area.
horaverse.solarRing.line3: The wheel whispers through proportion: overall energy {{overall}}, growth {{growth}}, challenge {{challenge}}. {{direction}}
horaverse.kaala.title: The witness behind the Hora opens one eye
horaverse.kaala.line1: KAALA is not a person in the chart. He is the silence around it, reading pattern without fear or praise.
horaverse.kaala.line2: The larger current is {{mahadasha}}, the long river shaping the season of life.
horaverse.kaala.line3: Inside it, {{antardasha}} moves like a smaller tide, changing timing, pressure, and openings.
horaverse.kaala.saturnLine: Saturn stands in house {{house}} with {{strength}} weight, asking time to be respected.
horaverse.kaala.saturnQuiet: Saturn stays quiet in the background, but time still keeps its count.
horaverse.innerFocus.title: Moon memory gathers in {{moonSign}}
horaverse.innerFocus.line1: This part is felt before it is explained. It is mood, instinct, comfort, and the place where reactions begin.
horaverse.innerFocus.line2: House {{house}}{{houseName}} becomes the room where the Moon repeats its private lesson.
horaverse.innerFocus.nakshatraLine: {{nakshatra}} pada {{pada}} adds a finer doorway to that emotional pattern.
horaverse.innerFocus.moonDoorway: The Moon keeps its doorway subtle here, asking for attention rather than noise.
horaverse.doorAhead.title: The chart points toward the next usable opening
horaverse.doorAhead.supportiveWindow: A supportive window exists, but it asks for steady action before it becomes visible.
horaverse.doorAhead.difficultPart: The difficult part is not punishment; it is the place where timing asks for maturity.
horaverse.doorAhead.currentPeriod: The current period of {{period}} is the thread to watch most carefully now.

dhruva.general.heading: General Jyotish Questions
dhruva.general.kundaliAnswer: A Kundali is a birth chart that maps the sky for a specific birth time and place. HoraLife uses it as the base for later chart calculations.
dhruva.general.ascendantAnswer: Ascendant, or Lagna, is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth. It is used as the starting point for reading houses.
dhruva.general.nakshatraAnswer: A Nakshatra is one of the lunar mansions used in Jyotish. It gives a finer reference for the Moon position and related timing systems.
dhruva.general.dashaAnswer: Dasha is a planetary period system in Jyotish. It helps organize when different planetary themes are considered active.
dhruva.general.mahadashaAntardashaAnswer: Mahadasha is the larger planetary period. Antardasha is a smaller period running inside it, adding more specific timing context.
dhruva.general.yogaAnswer: A Yoga is a named planetary combination. It should be understood from calculated chart data and the full chart context.
dhruva.general.doshaAnswer: A Dosha is a chart condition that may need careful reading. It should not be read with fear or judged in isolation.
